judge_issues.message: Citation 5 defined but not referenced in narrative
The provided content for citation [1] from Charity Navigator does not contain the specific financial details claimed (program expense ratio, working capital, fundraising efficiency).
The provided content for citation [3] from Form 990 (2023) does not contain the claimed total revenue for FY2024.
The provided content for citation [5] (College Catalog 2025-2026) is a PDF that could not be parsed to verify the claim about formal accreditation.
The provided content for citation [10] from the charity website 'Ways to Give' does not contain the specific claim about donation options.

The narrative states the college has a 'clear theory of change', but the 'Theory of Change' component in the score details is rated as 'DEVELOPING' (5/7) and suggests improvement to 'Document a clear theory of change'. This mischaracterization makes the rationale appear more positive than the underlying score component.

The charity is classified as ZAKAT-ELIGIBLE, but the provided information does not explicitly detail how funds are distributed to specific asnaf categories. While the mission of providing education can fall under 'Fi Sabilillah', there is no explicit mention of direct aid to the poor (Fuqara), needy (Masakin), debtors (Gharimin), or other asnaf categories.
Website citation for 'founded_year' uses homepage URL; deep link preferred
